Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. It is submitted by learned counsel appearing for the petitioner that out of agreement dated 09.11.2021, opposite party no. 2 paid Rs. 20 Lakhs to the petitioner in connection with purchase of a piece of land measuring about two kathas, description of which is available in the agreement itself.

3. It is submitted that both parties are relatives and when for any of the reasons, the agreement could not finalized, the present false criminal case was lodged by the opposite party no. 2 against the petitioner.

It is pointed out that petitioner, after cancellation of deal in terms of aforesaid Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.2209 of 2024(3) dt.10-07-2025 agreement, returned Rs. 20 Lakhs as received from opposite party no. 2.
The aforesaid amount, at the first instance, was returned to opposite party no. 2 on 25.01.2022, where petitioner returned Rs. 8 Lakhs and, on 05.02.2022

,
petitioner returned Rs. 7 Lakhs.
The balance amount of Rs. 5 Lakhs was also returned on 19.06.2023.
4. It is submitted that in view of aforesaid fact, cognizance for the offence punishable under Section 420 of the IPC not appears made out.

6.

Patna, shall remain stayed till further Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.2209 of 2024(3)
dt.10-07-2025 order.
7.
Let notice be issued to opposite party no. 2 by both modes, i.e. ordinary process as well as registered cover with A/D, for which requisites etc. must be filed within two weeks from today.
8. Re-notify this matter on 15.10.2025, position be retained.
